correctness.rationale: Acyclic leaf-fiber toggling provides a full combinatorial proof of the exact homotopy type: core projection prevents matching cycles across fibers, and every remaining core must equal V(G)-z with induced degree one at every core vertex. A connected n>=3 graph cannot make the whole core a 2-independence face. The 0-cell and at most one (n-2)-cell have forced attachments. A self-contained checker confirms 3804 connected rooted core cases mod two and acyclicity for 59 selected cases, but computation is not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Deleting a single whisker from a fully whiskered connected graph—previously known to have contractible second-independence complex—causes an exact arbitrary-dimensional integral sphere iff the entire root-deleted induced graph is a one-factor. The theorem gives a sharp topological perturbation classification for arbitrary connected cores, with infinitely many natural windmill examples, and resolves a meaningful topology-vs-local-graph-structure gap rather than an arbitrary numerical sample.
